result:
Implemented Phase 2 (Health/HealthKit) per SPEC.md §4:

- **`App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist`** — added `NSHealthShareUsageDescription` / `NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription`.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/app.entitlements`** — new file granting `com.apple.developer.healthkit`.
- **`types/references.d.ts`** — referenced the HealthKit typings (present in `@nativescript/types-ios` but excluded from the default common preset).
- **`app/services/health-kit.ts`** — new module wrapping `HKHealthStore` in promises: `getAccessStatus`, `requestAccess`, `logSteps`, `loadLast7Days`, using direct HealthKit interop (no third-party plugin, per §2).
- **`app/components/Health.vue`** — wired status line, buttons, and 7-day list to the service; refreshes on `navigatedTo` (fires every time the screen is shown, including back-navigation); rows formatted as `Fri Jul 25 — 1,000 steps` with `(today)` suffix and bold emphasis on today's row; denied/not-requested state shows `Health access needed`.

`ns build ios` succeeds and `vue-tsc --noEmit` reports no type errors. As instructed, I didn't launch the simulator or run UI automation — the build command was the only verification.
